label: Shape A contract: a new doctor command needs a router .md, an 8-key _routes.yaml row, an assets workflow YAML plus presentation txt, and route-validate.sh passing; the manifest states the add procedure verbatim

route-validate.sh enforces eight rules proven by self-test fixtures: B2 required keys, B3 existing router, C1 duplicate target, D1 asset exists, I1 script exists, J1 target-set parity with the router md, K1 read-only route must not declare a write, L1 activity coverage

Shape A overlaps /doctor:skill-advisor parent-skill, which already runs parent-skill-check.cjs and ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs (the first two README battery commands); 4 of the 6 battery commands have no doctor home

Shape B cost: a hub mode touches mode-registry, hub-router tieBreak/signals/classes, leaf-manifest, hand-edited ROUTER.md section 11, SKILL.md tables, stack-detection, root README, canary fixture plus authored twin, compiled manifest re-mint, graph-metadata and description.json; the two axes admit only workflow (acts on code) or surface (read-only evidence), and a setup mode is neither

Shape B routing dead end: hub-identity discovery classes are referenced by no mode scoring class, every vocabulary class is code-work vocabulary, surfaces are advisor-invisible, and the hub is entered by a code prompt or an explicit hint — a set-up-my-surface prompt would not route to a setup mode

Naming conventions: doctor commands are /doctor:<subsystem>, route targets are short nouns for the audited object; fitting candidates are a surface-setup target under a new /doctor:sk-code or under /doctor:skill-advisor; trigger_phrases are inert today because doctor dispatch is menu/argv-driven

Doctor commands are not advisor-routed and not in any hub command-metadata.json (grep of the three existing files: 0 hits); the sk-code hub carries zero doctor references in SKILL.md/README.md/ROUTER.md

The external user green battery already exists as six documented commands (README.md:1476-1483) and 3c's removal failure names the README block as the closure; the Q4 gap is packaging and a single read-only entry point, not missing checks

Mirroring a new doctor command is automated by sync-runtime-mirrors.cjs (.skilled/commands walk into .claude/commands); the manual residue is the README.txt index copies, which command-catalog-mirror-check.cjs treats as structural (drift drives exit 1)

Shape recommendation: a read-only surface-setup doctor surface (new /doctor:sk-code command or a surface-setup target under /doctor:skill-advisor) running the six-command README battery; the hub-mode shape is rejected on routing unreachability and 15+-file cost

reason: The doctor family registration, validation and mirroring contracts are all committed files; every claim in this iteration is a path:line read, so no throwaway copy was needed
